newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: CRICKET-ELAHI REPLACES SOHAIL IN PAKISTAN TEAM.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ELAHI REPLACES SOHAIL IN PAKISTAN TEAM.

text.p: Pakistan have replaced
experienced opener Aamir Sohail with Zahoor Elahi for the first
of two tests against New Zealand starting on Thursday.
The home side, hot favourites to beat the tourists after
defeating the New Zealanders in the Singer Champions' Cup final
in Sharjah, have also introduced 19-year-old middle-order
batsman Mohammad Wasim, who captained the Pakistan under-19 team
to the West Indies recently.
Inzamam-ul-Haq, who has recovered from knee surgery that
caused him to miss the series against Zimbabwe and the Singer
Trophy, is also included..
New Zealand, who have not beaten Pakistan since the 1984-85
2-0 win over Javed Miandad's side, have been dealt a severe
blow by the absence of main strike bowler Danny Morrison.
Morrison has flown home after the recurrence of a groin
muscle strain in the three-day match at Sahiwal on Monday. He
has been
replaced by Robert Kennedy, who has appeared in four tests.
"The absence of Morrison is indeed a big blow for us but we
have adequate cover to give Pakistan a real competition," said
captain Lee Germon.
The groundsman at Lahore's Gaddafi Stadium, Mohammad Bashir,
said he had prepared a pitch with enough grass to help pace
bowlers.
"I think the team winning the toss should put the opposition
in to get the maximum advantage from the pitch," he said.
Teams (from):
Pakistan - Saeed Anwar, Zahoor Elahi, Ijaz Ahmad,
Salim Malik, Inzamam-ul-Haq, Wasim Akram (captain), Moin Khan,
Saqlain Mushtaq, Waqar Younis, Mushtaq Ahmad, Shahid Nazir,
Mohammad Wasim.
New Zealand - Craig Spearman, Bryan Young, Adam
Parore, Stephen Fleming, Nathan Astle, Mark Greatbatch, Lee
Germon (captain), Justin Vaughan, Gavin Larsen, Simon Doull,
Chris Cairns, Dipak Patel, Matthew Hart, Robert Kennedy, Chris
Pringle.
